g.text: WHITE: two channels per disc, 2200 K and 3000 K, blended by the two dim lines. Same emitters and same watts as the single channel it replaced.

g.desc: WHITE: two channels per disc, 2200 K and 3000 K, blended by the two dim lines. Same emitters and same watts as the single channel it replaced.

g.text: CLIMATE: the globes must breathe or they fog. An ePTFE vent, a weep path and a coated board are the defences; the riser's I2C pair reaches a humidity sensor in the lowest globe of each post so that anyone can tell whether they are working. Heating is a supplement, not the mechanism — see orb_climate.py.

g.desc: CLIMATE: the globes must breathe or they fog. An ePTFE vent, a weep path and a coated board are the defences; the riser's I2C pair reaches a humidity sensor in the lowest globe of each post so that anyone can tell whether they are working. Heating is a supplement, not the mechanism — see orb_climate.py.

g.text: Every block is a sheet: TAKEOFF is 2/4, POST BASE is 3/4, ORB DISC is 4/4. The disc's physical layout is a separate .kicad_pcb.

g.desc: Every block is a sheet: TAKEOFF is 2/4, POST BASE is 3/4, ORB DISC is 4/4. The disc's physical layout is a separate .kicad_pcb.

g.text: VOLTAGE DOMAINS: pack (lethal, one plate) / 24 V (everything buried and in-post) / 5 V (pixel rail, made per disc) / 3.3 V (ESP32 logic, re-driven to 5 V before it leaves the base).

g.desc: VOLTAGE DOMAINS: pack (lethal, one plate) / 24 V (everything buried and in-post) / 5 V (pixel rail, made per disc) / 3.3 V (ESP32 logic, re-driven to 5 V before it leaves the base).

g.text: POST BASE to its 4 DISCS: ONE cable of 7 conductors (+24V, GND, DATA, W_PWM_A, W_PWM_B, SDA, SCL) to the first disc; the rest daisy-chain. It was drawn as four separate data lines until the disc's own J1->J2 chain contradicted it — a chain has one input.

g.desc: POST BASE to its 4 DISCS: ONE cable of 7 conductors (+24V, GND, DATA, W_PWM_A, W_PWM_B, SDA, SCL) to the first disc; the rest daisy-chain. It was drawn as four separate data lines until the disc's own J1->J2 chain contradicted it — a chain has one input.

g.text: TAKEOFF to each POST: 24 V regulated, 2.02 A nominal / 2.43 A at the 20 V design floor, 14 AWG buried 60 ft, F_P{1,2} 5 A blade (32 V rated — legal on THIS side only).

g.desc: TAKEOFF to each POST: 24 V regulated, 2.02 A nominal / 2.43 A at the 20 V design floor, 14 AWG buried 60 ft, F_P{1,2} 5 A blade (32 V rated — legal on THIS side only).

g.text: WHOLE SYSTEM: 2 posts x 4 discs = 8 orb discs, 97.1 W flat out, 4.05 A of the converter's 6.5 A (62%).

g.desc: WHOLE SYSTEM: 2 posts x 4 discs = 8 orb discs, 97.1 W flat out, 4.05 A of the converter's 6.5 A (62%).

g.text: PACK to TAKEOFF: 160-233.6 VDC, 0.71 A worst, inches of cable, F_HV 2 A DC-rated to 1000 V.
